[SWS_DM_00240] Processing the Aging counter
⌈
The DM shall only al-
low processing the Aging counter if the related DTC is stored in the event memory,
the status is qualified as passed (’testFailed’ bit is set to 0) and healing, according to
[SWS_DM_00238], is fulfilled.
